title: Junior Accessibility Engineer
abolSummaryText: Junior Accessibility Engineer is a full-time role with Abol Learn Studio in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Pay is 18,000–28,000 USD per year; apply by 31 December 2026.
description:
Help teams ship captions, keyboard paths, and clear learning tools.

You will:
- Test Abol Kit player and job-card embeds for keyboard and screen-reader paths
- File clear accessibility bugs with reproduction steps
- Pair with educators on inclusive media and caption workflows

Nice to have: basic HTML/CSS, interest in Ethiopian language captions, and comfort writing plain-language notes.
